data.name: Aaliyan
data.gender_notes: Aaliyan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aaliyan is derived from the Arabic root 'A-L-Y', meaning 'exalted' or 'elevated'. It signifies a person of high status or nobility. The name Aaliyan carries the meaning “Exalted, Elevated, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aaliyan usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, elevated, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Aaliyan reflects the Islamic value of striving for moral elevation and closeness to Allah.
data.etymology: Aaliyan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Elevated, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaliyan total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_english.name: Aaliyan
in_english.meaning: high rank, elevated, exalted, sublime, noble, lofty
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aaliyan is derived from the Arabic root 'a-l-' (علي) which means high rank, elevated, exalted, sublime, noble, and lofty. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the Prophet Muhammad and is considered a name of praise and nobility. The name Aaliyan is also mentioned in the Quran as a title given to the righteous and the prophets. It is a name that symbolizes spiritual elevation and closeness to Allah.
